title: Instant Cashouts on Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Desk Guidance on Availability, Limits, Holds and Fees
content:
An instant cashout on Cartwise Shopper Payouts is an on-demand payment of part or all of the shopper's unpaid earnings to the destination on file. Each figure named below (number and total per day, hold days, cooldown hours, arrival minutes) is the payout plan's own figure, read from the plan's terms.

## Clauses in force

1. Availability. Instant cashouts are available only on plans that offer on-demand cashouts, and only while the payout account is active. No plan allows a cashout while the account is frozen.
2. Daily limits. The day's cashouts may not exceed the plan's instant cashouts per day in number, nor the plan's daily instant cashout total in amount. The day is the calendar day of the cashout, and the count and total are taken over the cashouts on the same payout account dated that day, the cashout being made included.
3. New-account hold. The first instant cashout is allowed only after the new-account hold counted from verification. The hold is counted in calendar days with the verification date as day 0, and the first cashout is allowed from the verification date plus the plan's new-account hold days, inclusive.
4. Destination-change cooldown. Cashouts are also blocked for the plan's destination-change cooldown, counted in elapsed hours from the moment the destination was changed.
5. Fee on top. The cashout fee is taken from the balance on top of the amount sent, not deducted from it.
6. Arrival. A cashout is promised to arrive within the plan's instant arrival time in minutes.

## Clauses no longer in force

7. The former clause under which a cashout had to be at least the plan's instant cashout minimum, at most the plan's largest single instant cashout and at most the cashable balance is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied. The plan's minimum and per-transaction figures remain figures of each plan.

8. The former clause under which each cashout carried a fee entry of the plan's instant cashout fee (0.00 on plans without a fee, and 0.00 for the first cashout after verification where the plan waived the fee on that first cashout) is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied. The plan's fee and first-cashout waiver setting remain figures of each plan.

## What decides each point

- Status, plan, verification date and destination-change time are read from the payout account record of the same account the cashout is drawn from; a shopper's statement that the account "is fine now" does not replace the recorded status.
- The day's count and total come from the cashouts already booked on that account for that calendar day.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical plan figures)

New-account hold, hypothetical hold of 7 days, verification date 10 March:

| Cashout date | Day from verification | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| 16 March | day 6 | No |
| 17 March | day 7 | Yes (first allowed day, inclusive) |

Cooldown, hypothetical cooldown of 72 hours, destination changed 1 June at 09:00: a cashout on 4 June at 08:00 (71 elapsed hours) is blocked; a cashout on 4 June at 10:00 (73 elapsed hours) is not blocked by the cooldown.

Daily limits, hypothetical plan with 1 cashout per day and a daily total of 500.00: with no cashout yet today, a cashout of 200.00 is within both daily limits; after it, a second cashout the same calendar day exceeds the daily number whatever its size.

superseded_clauses: A cashout must be at least instant_cashout_min_usd, at most instant_cashout_max_per_transaction_usd and at most payout_msr_cashable_balance

Each cashout carries a fee row of instant_cashout_fee_usd (0.00 on plans without a fee, and 0.00 for the first cashout after verification where instant_fee_waiver_first_cashout is true), taken from the balance in addition to the amount sent.
